name: Deformable 3D Gaussians
definition: A framework for modeling monocular dynamic scenes that extends static 3D-GS by learning 3D Gaussians in canonical space with a deformation field to model time-varying geometry, enabling real-time rendering and high-fidelity reconstruction.
summary: Deformable 3D Gaussians reconstructs dynamic scenes by learning time-independent Gaussians in canonical space and using a lightweight deformation field to map them to deformed positions at any time.
